edges: The elder son convinced Moll to marry his younger brother.
Moll Flanders married the younger brother after being persuaded by the elder brother.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Moll revealed her entire story to her Lancashire husband after her brother/husband died.
Feemy is called to witness against Blanco.
Moll learned that her mother-in-law was not related to her, meaning her husband was not her half-brother.
Moll and a Quaker founded a farm with 50 servants in Maryland.
The woman denies that Blanco was the man who gave her the horse.
Moll's son became her steward and provided her with income from her mother's inheritance.
Moll Flanders is the daughter of Moll's mother.
Moll's first husband went bankrupt and fled to the Continent.
Blanco left his brother's house before being accused.
Moll Flanders became involved with banker Callum Murray, who was still married.
Blanco Posnet is accused of stealing a horse belonging to the Sheriff.
Moll Flanders was raised by a goodly foster mother until adolescence.
Moll Flanders married a kindly man who introduced her to his mother.
Moll married Bretton, who cheated her into marriage.
